audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Aurora all seven stages. Every why on those rows says the opposite ('You lead at 1', 'your kit bullies her', 'you still win'), the packet chart reads Garen for the first five and Garen again at two items, and Garen wins 55.78% over 2058 games.
audit.why: This is the single worst contradiction on the page: seven chart rows telling the reader to concede a lane the same page tells them they dominate. The mirror audit flagged the identical problem from Aurora's side.
audit.corrected: Whole chart proposed as one group in both layers: Garen levels 1 through 6... specifically Garen at Levels 1, 2, 3, 4-5 and 6, a skill check at first item, Garen at two items — matching the packet chart and the existing whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] says 'Her R walls off an area'. Between Worlds does not create a wall: she leaps, releases a shockwave that damages and slows, then leaves an area that slows enemies inside it and lets HER teleport from one side to the other. No cooldown was given anywhere; it is 140/120/100.
audit.why: 'Wall' tells the reader they are blocked in. They are not — they are slowed, and she is the one who gains the teleport. That flips the correct response from 'I am trapped' to 'walk out sideways'.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now states the leap, the slowing shockwave, the zone she teleports across, the 140s rank-1 cooldown, and that it slows rather than walls. Across the Veil's 22s rank-1 cooldown added as the engage trigger in spikes[2], mid and wants.you[0].
sources: champ-data/_kits/aurora.json R text and cd 140/120/100, W cd 22/21/20/19/18

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's defect list says this matchup never names a single Aurora ability, and the fields that try to invent names get them wrong: the full layer tracks 'Twofold Hunt (Blink)' in five places and the content layer calls her W 'Twilight' four times. Her W is Across the Veil; her Q is Twofold Hex. The one real mechanic — that Twofold Hex curses on the missile and is RECAST to drag the curses back — was never stated, which is exactly what Decisive Strike's silence denies.
audit.why: 'Twofold Hunt (Blink)' and 'Twilight' do not exist in her kit. And the silence is only worth timing if you know there is a recast to deny.
audit.corrected: Content layer now names Twofold Hex and its recast (whys[2], spikes[0], mid), Across the Veil with its 22s cooldown (spikes[2], early, mid, wants), Between Worlds (spikes[1], whys[5], wants), The Weirding and Spirit Abjuration. The 'Twofold Hunt (Blink)' strings in the full layer are out of band and flagged instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] says Merc Treads shrug 'her ult zone and roots'. Aurora has no root anywhere in her kit — Between Worlds slows, The Weirding slows.
audit.why: Tenacity advice attached to CC that does not exist. The slow is real, so the item is still right; the reason was not.
audit.corrected: Re-pointed at the real effect: Merc Treads for Between Worlds' slow zone.
sources: champ-data/_kits/aurora.json E/R slow flags, no root anywhere

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer is scraped source text — 'Garen Top Lane Matchup Database (1-70) 78' appears in tradeGood, breakdown.trading, dosFull[1].d and report[3].t, with a level chart pasted into winCon, enemyWin, report[1].t. dosFull[0].t reads 'Track his Aurora Aurora hopping mobility and spirit gate ultimate'.
audit.why: These render to the reader as advice.
audit.corrected: Not repaired — outside the +/-10% band. Flagged for a structural pass.

notes: Two invented ability names were in circulation on this page: 'Twofold Hunt (Blink)' (full layer, five fields) and 'Twilight' (content layer, four fields). Neither exists — her W is Across the Veil, her Q is Twofold Hex. The content-layer instances are fixed here; the full-layer ones sit inside scraped PDF text ('Garen Top Lane Matchup Database (1-70) 78') that cannot be repaired inside the length band. The anti-heal note from the missing-interactions feed is now carried: Spirit Abjuration heals her off spirits exorcised from anyone she damages, so extended trades feed her and Grievous Wounds timing matters.
